auth.email_subject_verify_email.description: Subject of the email verification message.

auth.email_body_verify_email.description: Body of the email verification message. {{.Link}} is the verification URL.
auth.email_body_verify_email.other: Welcome to Lahijan. Please verify your email by opening this link within 24 hours: {{.Link}}

auth.email_body_reset_password.description: Body of the password-reset email. {{.Link}} is the reset URL.
auth.email_body_reset_password.other: You requested a password reset. Open this link within 1 hour to choose a new password: {{.Link}}. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

auth.email_body_email_changed.description: Body of the email-changed notice. {{.NewEmail}} is the new address.
auth.email_body_email_changed.other: Your Lahijan account email was changed to {{.NewEmail}}. If this was not you, contact your operator immediately.

auth.err_email_taken.other: An account with this email already exists.

auth.err_email_unverified.other: Please verify your email before logging in.

auth.err_invalid_token.other: This token is invalid, expired, or already used.

auth.err_refresh_reuse.other: Refresh token reuse detected; all sessions for this login have been revoked.

auth.err_password_too_weak.other: Password is too weak. Use at least {{.Min}} characters with a mix of letters, digits, and symbols.

auth.err_email_invalid.other: A valid email address is required.

auth.err_pat_expired.other: This personal access token has expired.

auth.err_forbidden.other: You do not have permission to do that.

auth.err_internal.other: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.err_pat_name_required.other: A name is required for the personal access token.

auth.err_scopes_invalid.other: One or more requested scopes are not allowed.

auth.msg_email_sent.other: If that account exists, an email is on its way.

auth.msg_pat_revoked.other: The personal access token has been revoked.
